envelope.note:
reused: testkit.world, testkit.run, testkit.fakes
World owns HOME, the XDG roots and TMPDIR; every subprocess goes through run with a timeout; Result.refusal() asserts the wire. land.py is staged through World.stage with instrument.py and laneconf.py beside them (HANDOFF-2026-09-13-wall-migration.md). No planted fake tool (this module has none). Kit gap: World.git() uses a fixed identity (Test User); this family needs Repo Config as a third identity distinct from LANE_AUTHOR and WF_AGENT, so git goes through run with git_env. World.env() injects GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* which invoke strips so they do not leak into the act. No regression rows were added because this was a behavior-preserving migration.
